summary: Cut the six approved redundancies. Removed DuelPromo (component + usage), relocating its single paid-only ranked-chips/tournaments callout into the merged leaderboard block (gated on PAID_DUELS_ENABLED_PUBLIC). Deleted the duplicate climber-count SocialProofStrip (and its duplicate getGlobalClimbStats read). Trimmed the core-mechanic restatement from the ChooseYourClimb 1v1 card. Merged RankedLeaderboard + FreeLeaderboard into one compact LeaderboardTeaser block showing top-3 per board (was top-8) as a server-rendered responsive pair (no tab widget). Collapsed the sign-in ask by removing ChooseYourClimb's 'Already climbing? Sign in' line (nav + footer remain canonical), keeping only the distinct native-app beta link. Rewrote the stale AC-27..AC-32 page.tsx docstring to match today's DOM. All seven gates pass; / stays ISR (static, revalidate 1m). No frozen-test assertions needed changing.

decisions.what: Deleted DuelPromo.tsx and its <DuelPromo/> usage. Confirmed only page.tsx (usage) and ChooseYourClimb.tsx (a stale docstring comment, updated) referenced it. Paid-only exception: relocated the single 'Ranked chip duels + tournaments … 18+, not available in all states' callout verbatim into LeaderboardTeaser, rendered above the boards and gated on PAID_DUELS_ENABLED_PUBLIC (same flag DuelPromo used). When the flag is off (default) nothing renders — no relocation visible, matching prior behaviour.

Removed entirely. Its 'N climbers · free duels always on' duplicated the Hero stat strip's climber count one screen up, and 'free duels' is already in the Hero eyebrow. Deletion also removed a second independent getGlobalClimbStats() DB read (perf win); the Hero's read via HomePage is untouched.

Trimmed the ChooseYourClimb 1v1 card from 'One tower, one lava front, two climbers. Last above wins.' to 'Challenge a friend or queue a random rival for a live head-to-head.' — its distinct value (multiplayer entry modes) rather than a restatement of the shared mechanic. Left the Hero pitch and FAQ #1 as the two canonical mechanic statements; did NOT touch AboutDoomstack (intentional SEO).

New LeaderboardTeaser server component. Chose a SIMPLE responsive server-rendered pair (side-by-side at lg, stacked below) over a tab-widget client island. Rationale: the landing is the ISR/static high-traffic surface — a stacked/side-by-side pair keeps both async server reads (topFreeClimbers / chipLeaderboard, each .catch(()=>[])) in the same server tree with zero client JS and no new endpoint, and paid-off default renders the free board alone (no lone tab — same 'one option isn't a choice' principle as the tier pills). Each board now fetches top-3 (was 8) and keeps its exact empty state. The child components are AWAITED inside LeaderboardTeaser (const board = await FreeLeaderboard()) so the merged block renders as one already-resolved tree — required because legacy renderToStaticMarkup (and the frozen test) can't resolve nested async server-component elements, and it keeps FreeLeaderboard/RankedLeaderboard as self-fetching no-arg async components (the shape the frozen test invokes).

Removed ChooseYourClimb's 'Already climbing? Sign in to keep your records' line. Navbar 'Sign in' (NavbarAuth) and the Footer 'Get started' band remain the canonical asks. Kept the 'Join the app beta' link (→/beta): verified beta is pitched nowhere else on the landing (BetaBanner is dashboard-only), so it's a distinct destination that may stay per DESIGN.md. Removed the now-unused SIGNIN_HREF import.

Left Hero copy UNCHANGED (task: 'the Hero pitch is fine'; it is also a frozen contract). Tightened only the ChooseYourClimb 1v1 card (item 3) so each card is a distinct one-liner (Solo/1v1/Daily) that does not re-pitch the hero. Both sections retained.

learnings.insight: Legacy react-dom/server renderToStaticMarkup (used by every LandingPage DOM-contract test) does NOT resolve nested async server-component ELEMENTS (<Child/> where Child is async). It only renders an already-resolved tree. The frozen climbFeelSurfaces test works because it invokes the leaf directly: `const el = await FreeLeaderboard()`.
learnings.action: When composing async server components inside another async server component that must stay unit-testable this way, AWAIT the children into the parent (`const board = await FreeLeaderboard(); return <section>{board}</section>`) instead of `<FreeLeaderboard/>`. This is also valid at runtime in Next and preserves each leaf as a self-fetching no-arg component (so the leaf's own frozen test keeps passing).
